info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Ecommerce Cart Coupons-v5-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Coupon Listing API allows clients to retrieve a list of available coupons that can be applied to user shopping carts. This functionality is essential for enhancing customer engagement by offering discounts and promotions in real-time. Retailers and e-commerce platforms can utilize this API to display applicable coupons during the checkout process, ensuring customers make informed purchasing decisions. By leveraging this API, businesses can drive sales and improve customer satisfaction through targeted promotional offerings.

get.summary: Retrieve the current coupon from the shopping cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the currently applied coupon in the shopping cart. It provides valuable information about discounts and offers available for the user, ensuring that the cart reflects the most recent promotional codes.
